channels.detail: The v1.2.1 GitHub Release will be verified after the protected-main merge and annotated tag publication.
The npm package version, gitHead, integrity, and runtime smoke tests will be verified after publication.
The sdist, expected wheel matrix, artifact hashes, runtime smoke tests, and chemistry gates will be verified after publication.
The complete crates.io publish graph will be verified after publication.
The version-pinned docs.rs endpoint will be verified after crates.io publication.
The deployed site and displayed current version will be verified after the release publication workflow completes.
